note: Help text for alerts that have none in rules.json (the overall alert and the pattern). Read by the detail view.

isolation_overall.label: Overall: isolation
isolation_overall.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from this module's indicators; you do not measure it.
isolation_overall.whyItMatters: It combines the module's signals into one status so no single reading raises an alert alone. Act means follow the suggested action and contact the flight surgeon.
isolation_overall.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card. For Act, contact the flight surgeon.

combined_strain.label: Possible combined strain
combined_strain.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from sleep, mood and stress, reaction time and social contact; you do not measure it.
combined_strain.whyItMatters: Several small changes at the same time can be a possible sign of strain that one reading would not show.
combined_strain.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card and talk to the flight surgeon or crew support.
